answer.explanation: The application service computes business rules over the fridge's stock state. It takes the minimum of requested units and on-hand stock, works out the shortfall, and decides on an urgent O-negative red-cell substitution. It then computes the cover quantities and the stock to take. It reads onHand from the fridge and calls take with the results, so the stock-allocation and substitution logic runs in the service instead of inside the fridge aggregate/entity. Fulfilment.of only wraps the computed numbers. The domain objects hold state, but the calculation is done outside them.
